title: Retrospective prediction of released glial-behavior state proxy
disposition_reason: The current declaration targets a released freeze_vec proxy with unresolved raw movement/freezing polarity and clock provenance. It describes a full28-context unscored producer but delivers no executable producer or grader; interpreting its output as verified future freezing would overstate both target identity and causality.

scientific_target.question: Within the selected processed sessions, do preceding glial features improve prediction of the released behavior-state proxy over matched recent-state history, and do reverse/shift controls remove that gain?
scientific_target.known_answer: A bounded future-window fraction of the released freeze_vec proxy under the original finite-task window definition. Until polarity and clock mapping are verified, this is not asserted to equal the animal’s physical freezing fraction.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Released processed behavior vector paired with astrocytic calcium in Zenodo21780255. The original task assumes a future freezing label; the historical runtime explicitly retains unresolved raw behavior convention and clock lineage.
scientific_target.case_unit: One fixed query interval within a held session; historical declaration has70 unique query IDs repeated across four information/control arms.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Seven mice, two selected sessions per mouse; query intervals and four arms are nested repeated measurements.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective prediction of a deposited behavior proxy. Whole-session preprocessing and session-specific cell axes prevent a strictly causal online or neuron-transfer claim without further preparation.
exclusions: No verified physical-freezing interpretation until behavior polarity/timing closes.
No assertion that astrocytes cause future freezing.
280 arm predictions are70 query identities, not280 independent biological cases.

inputs: Past glial features and permitted preceding proxy-state history from the source-defined window; session-local cell axes remain separate.
Matched joint/history/reverse/shift information arms; only training-session targets supplied to the participant.
forbidden_inputs: Future proxy-state values, query target fractions and full-trace lookahead.
Raw behavior filenames or context/mouse identity fields that encode outcomes.
Other task packets exposing the same future trace interval or target labels.
observation_contract.case_identity: Historical manifest specifies28 contexts=7 held-mouse pairs×4 arms; each has12 training sessions,2 held sessions,60 training targets and10 queries, yielding280 predictions over70 unique query IDs. Actual IDs, window lengths and horizons are not distributed.
observation_contract.split: Declared held-mouse setup excludes both of a mouse’s sessions from its12-session training set. Exact time windows/horizon require original executable recovery; inherited whole-session preprocessing means retrospective, not strict online causal evaluation.
observation_contract.coverage: Complete selected seven mice and14 sessions across four arms; does not cover the whole original release. The current checkout contains the registered declaration only.

primary.name: equal_mouse_history_mae_minus_joint_mae_on_released_proxy
primary.aggregation: MAE within each session and mouse, then equal mean over seven mice; compare same70 query IDs in history and joint arms.
primary.rationale: Tests incremental signal about a measured deposited target while explicitly refusing to rename an unresolved proxy as physical freezing.

secondary: Report absolute proxy MAE for joint/history/reverse/shift arms and all per-mouse differences.
Validity/calibration for predicted fractions in[0,1], support per session and target-window prevalence.
Expose whether reverse/shift controls retain apparent gains, which would weaken temporal neural interpretation.

comparators.name: Recent proxy history
comparators.procedure: Fixed training-fold-only mean/persistence or regularized history model; exact original procedure must be recovered and kept matched.

comparators.name: Joint past glial and history
comparators.inputs: Same history plus pre-query glial features.
comparators.procedure: Same split, learner budget and target coverage as history-only.

comparators.name: Reverse and shifted glial
comparators.inputs: Same history plus source-defined time-reversed or shifted neural features.
comparators.procedure: Retain both historical control arms; recover shift/edge conventions before interpreting their null behavior.

nuisance_controls: Verify timestamp units, interpolation, horizon and behavior polarity before using the word freezing as ground truth.
Keep both sessions of a mouse together and preserve session-local cell axes.
Use only causal feature windows for the prediction contract, while retaining whole-session preprocessing as a documented violation of strict online causality.
Compare all four arms on identical eligibility/support with matched compute and no query feedback.
evaluation.uncertainty: Seven paired mouse differences, with all70 identities retained. Do not count four arms or280 outputs as independent evidence; no population inference from missing/undefined units.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all declared query×arm IDs and finite predictions in[0,1] before targets. Missing windows, invalid proxy alignment and unverified horizon block target interpretation; retain failure rather than silently replacing the proxy or scoring a subset.
